children: France biopharma firm's H1 2026 revenue fell sharply due to lower feasibility study income
Net loss for H1 2026 narrowed slightly as operating expenses decreased
Company flagged material uncertainty on going concern, cash runway seen through early Q2 2027
Company says cash runway secured until beginning of Q2 2027, assuming no new partnership revenue
Company discloses material uncertainty regarding going concern in half-year report
Company is seeking additional financing and new strategic partnerships while reducing costs
FEASIBILITY STUDY INCOME - H1 2026 revenue was mainly from a feasibility study on a novel peptide combination using BioChaperone, with lower income than prior year studies
OPERATING EXPENSES REDUCTION - Lower operating expenses due to reduced share-based payment expense, foreign exchange impact, and decreased personnel costs
FINANCIAL EXPENSES INCREASE - Higher financial expenses from non-cash IFRS charge for warrants linked to shareholder loan, partly offset by investment income
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 4 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the biotechnology & medical research peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Adocia SA is €12.00, about 239.6% above its September 23 closing price of €3.53
